# Summit Valor

> Summit Valor provides business consulting and entrepreneurial development for founders and growing businesses.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.summitvalor.com.ng/): Overview of Summit Valor and its services.
- [Business consulting services](https://www.summitvalor.com.ng/services): Service catalogue, paid consultation options, and what happens after a consultation.
- [About Summit Valor](https://www.summitvalor.com.ng/about): Organisation overview, approach, and audiences served.
- [Industries](https://www.summitvalor.com.ng/industries): Industries and business contexts supported.
- [Resources](https://www.summitvalor.com.ng/resources): Business resources and downloadable materials.
- [Blog](https://www.summitvalor.com.ng/blog): Business operations and founder-focused articles.
- [Contact](https://www.summitvalor.com.ng/contact): Contact and enquiry options.
